mode.description: Search mode: 'ioc' for IOC lookup, 'timeline' for chronological activity.

query.description: IOC to search for (IP address, domain name, or port number).

src_ip.description: Filter timeline to only show events where this is the source IP.

dst_ip.description: Filter timeline to only show events where this is the destination IP.

src_port.description: Filter timeline to only show events with this source port.

dst_port.description: Filter timeline to only show events with this destination port.

proto.description: Filter timeline by protocol (e.g. TCP, UDP).
